import math
x=[559,561,635,553]; n=len(x); s=sum(x); v=60**2; a=578; t=10**2

mx=max(ls); den=sum(math.exp(z-mx) for z in ls); logB=mx+math.log(den/900)
p=1/(1+math.exp(logB-logA)); muB=sum(k*math.exp(z-mx) for k,z in zip(range(100,1000),ls))/den
print(m,p,muB,p*m+(1-p)*muB)
PY"
